scope: Museum Collectie Brands at Herenstreek 11 in August 2024, including the thatched Brands farmhouse and the attached 2011 library and exhibition wing.

originalReview.notes: The Qualla image is a resized rendition of the same first-party CC0 photo. The Wikimedia rendition and local image match in framing and architectural content, with minor encoding and color differences. The view shows the brick farmhouse with steep thatch and the flat-roofed masonry and timber museum wing.
